title: Generic resource graph productization wave 2
goal: Attempt up to 20 exact-live generic resource graph product promotions beyond the phase-1 stdio pipe marker, but ship only rows that independently satisfy the product contract. Classify the candidate rows into promote-now, promote-after-missing-refusal, blocked-by-tree-identity, blocked-by-service-safety, or blocked-by-session-state; implement the first genuinely close batch of 5-8 rows; and explicitly defer every row that lacks support/refusal/inventory/docs/API/coverage/retained-artifact evidence. Preserve the core boundary: no arbitrary process restore, no any-binary movement, no broad daemon/database/service migration, no active session migration, no source-fd teleportation, no source-ISA emulation, no metadata-only success, no runtime-profile shortcut, and no proof-image or proof-harness dependency as product support.
